～Chapter 4～
An SOS from the Dark

Is everyone here?
Good, then let’s begin.
We were able to confirm our previous assumptions during this last sortie.
We now know for sure that there’s a new threat within the Mikasa, seeking the Regalia...
Isn’t that right, Kaede?
That’s right.

But who this threat is,
and what their goals are...
That we still don’t know.
That demon that was guarding the sword, his last words were...
“Don’t think you’ve won just yet”... The heck’s THAT supposed to mean?
Probably that there are still more demons left in the Mikasa.
Were the other Regalia taken by the demons, too?
That’s definitely likely.
What could they possibly be wanting with this “Pandemonium Regalia” anyway?
That we still don’t know, which is precisely why we must continue our investigation.
Again, we don’t even know who they are, nor their ultimate goal.
Which is why we have to retrieve the Regalia, and fast, or who knows what might happen...
Exactly. We have to recover them as quickly as possible.
This time, alongside <NAME>’s team, we’ll be sending out one more.
With two separate teams, we should hopefully be able to settle this case for good.
Kanna, Iris, I want you two to form the other team.
Alright, <NAME>, time to move out!
